unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Time-kill, membrane-probe, cytotoxicity, and intracellular-replication figures provide curves/bars but the local text extraction does not expose all underlying per-timepoint numeric series. Text-supported values and claims were recorded; missing curve internals were not invented.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking: publication-grade conclusions use source-supported table values, textual exact values, and bounded figure-level qualitative claims rather than fabricated curve points.
